title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: SMS delivery failures to Telemat Cel Brazil subscribers are ongoing.
backbase_rationale: Twilio is monitoring the issue; no immediate action is required from Backbase.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The removal of the Send to Coworker action in SendGrid Domain Authentication simplifies the flow and improves security by eliminating low-usage email-based DNS record updates.
backbase_rationale: Reduce complexity and enhance security by eliminating email-based DNS record updates.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android SDK level of 24, which may affect apps targeting lower Android versions.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must update its integration to support Android API level 24 or higher.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: The SDK now includes updates to meet WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should assess its applications for WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are met.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe France
impact_summary: SMS delivery delays to Free Caraibe France subscribers are due to an identified issue.
backbase_rationale: Twilio has identified and is resolving the issue; Backbase can monitor the situation.
